author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Dashboard
description: Scaffolds an empty Dataverse dashboard skeleton (Dashboard XML with empty <tabs>) and registers it as a root component (type=60) in Solution.xml. Pass --DashboardId to choose a specific GUID; if omitted, a fresh GUID is generated automatically.

SolutionRootPath.description: Path to the solution root directory (default: '.')

DashboardName.description: Display name of the dashboard (shown as <LocalizedName>)

DashboardId.description: GUID for the dashboard. If omitted, a fresh GUID is auto-generated by the post-action. Accepts both braced ({xxx-xxx-xxx-xxx-xxxxxxxx}) and unbraced (xxx-xxx-xxx-xxx-xxxxxxxx) formats.

manualInstructions.text: Set dashboard FormId, rename file, and register in Solution.xml

postActions.description: Set FormId, rename file, register dashboard in Solution.xml
